editorial:
Imagine you are just walking down the street when a speeding ambulance pulls up and kidnaps you. That is exactly what happens to three young women in this wild ride. You will feel the panic as they wake up in a creepy medical center where the doctors are not there to help. Instead, they are running a scary business selling healthy organs on the black market. It feels like a nightmare where you are trapped in a cold, sterile place with people who view you as nothing more than a set of spare parts. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you wonder who will make it out alive.

You will notice that the movie keeps a steady clip, and the scares come from the idea of being helpless. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the cheesy style of the late eighties. If you love old-school thrillers with a mean streak, you should definitely give this one a shot.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a frantic fight for survival as the women try to escape the facility. You see the evil doctors get their comeuppance in a violent way. The main twist involves the scale of the organ ring and how deep the corruption goes. Eventually, the survivors manage to break free and bring the whole operation crashing down, ensuring that the black market killers are stopped for good before they can take more lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s B-movies and medical horror.
